Players Committee card image of [[The Force Is Strong With This One (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If your Padawan or Skywalker is in battle with a Dark Jedi, either add one battle destiny or cancel I Have You Now. OR If Luke is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
